name: Gemini
summary: Google's Gemini assistant: the Gemini app for personal and Workspace accounts, and Gemini Enterprise for organizations, which takes Agent Skills, custom MCP servers and A2A agents.

skills.what: Gemini Enterprise skills are packages with a required SKILL.md (name and description front matter) and optional scripts, references and assets; an admin turns the feature on, and Frontline edition can use but not upload skills.

mcp.what: Gemini Enterprise connects to a custom MCP server set up as a data store in the app, over HTTPS with the StreamableHTTP transport only (SSE is not supported).

sources.title: Set up your custom MCP server data store

a2a.what: Administrators register A2A agents hosted on any platform so users can reach them in the Gemini Enterprise web app (preview, A2A v0.3); serving Gemini's own agents over A2A was not found.

scheduled-work.what: Schedules (scheduled actions) in the Gemini app run recurring prompts in the background before a chosen delivery time, up to 10 active, for personal accounts (rolling out) and qualifying Workspace editions.
